recognize_zh: 骨髓切片網狀纖維染色（reticulin）中可見密集、粗細不一且大量交叉的黑色纖維包圍幾乎每顆細胞，並呈平行流線狀排列，顯示明顯增加的網狀纖維化（約 MF-2 至 MF-3），與急性巨核母細胞白血病常見的骨髓纖維化相符。
features: Silver-impregnated black reticulin fibers forming a dense, diffuse meshwork
Extensive fiber intersections surrounding individual cells
Thick, coarse bundles with parallel streaming orientation
Pink-counterstained cells trapped within the fiber network
Fat spaces and possible sinusoids distorted by fibrosis
describe_en: Reticulin stain of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers with extensive intersections and focal coarse bundles in a streaming pattern, corresponding to approximately grade MF-2 to MF-3. Collagen deposition cannot be assessed without a trichrome stain. The degree of fibrosis explains aspiration difficulty (dry tap) and, in the context of an immature megakaryocytic infiltrate, is consistent with acute megakaryoblastic leukemia with marrow fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Similar fibrosis grade, but PMF shows clustered atypical mature megakaryocytes and osteosclerosis rather than blasts; cellular composition on H&E and CD34/CD61 stains separates them.
Equivalent fibrosis with a trilineage blast-rich proliferation; lineage immunohistochemistry is needed to distinguish.
Reticulin cannot separate these; keratin immunostaining identifies metastatic epithelial cells.
HCL produces fine diffuse reticulin fibrosis around spaced cells with fried-egg morphology that are CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positive.
